A.notes: Executes the brief reliably with a literal but cohesive door motif and solid accessibility fundamentals. While the typography is elegant, the overall layout feels a bit safe and blocky compared to high-end boutique expectations.

B.notes: Presents a highly sophisticated, editorial design with gorgeous typographic hierarchy and a strong central visual motif. Unfortunately, it fails the contrast hard gate (likely on inline links or gold kicker labels), invalidating an otherwise excellent aesthetic execution.

raw.why: Although Site B possesses a vastly superior and premium aesthetic, Site A wins by default as Site B fails a hard gate for text contrast.
